summary: SLM Corp filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered offering of $500M aggregate principal amount of 6.495% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2032. The notes bear initial fixed interest at 6.495% through May 15, 2031, then float at Compounded SOFR plus 271 bps. Price to public is 100%, underwriting discount 1%, net proceeds $495M. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, unlisted, and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. Joint book-running managers are J.P. Morgan and Barclays. This is a plain-vanilla debt issuance, not a special situation.
